skills.name: novel-to-game
skills.tagline_zh: 喂给它一本小说，它按原著设定拆世界观、出美术方向、直接把游戏做出来——真的能玩。
skills.tagline_en: Feed it a novel; it extracts the world, art-directs it, and builds a genuinely playable game grounded in the source text.
skills.desc_en: Turn a novel into a fully playable game on the selected target platform. Orchestrates the whole adaptation pipeline — requirements intake, gameable deconstruction, concept selection, world and visual design, target-runtime build, and evidence-based QA — for a novel in any language. Use for novel to game, story to game, book to game, adapt this novel into a game, turn this book into a playable prot
skills.why_zh: 「把喜欢的小说做成能玩的游戏」是很多人的童年梦想，这个 skill 把整条流水线打包好了，交给 Claude Code 就能开工。
skills.why_en: Turning a beloved book into a playable game is a childhood dream for a lot of people — this packages the whole pipeline so Claude Code can just get to work.

skills.name: oh-story-claudecode
skills.tagline_zh: 网文工业流水线：扫榜、拆文、长短篇写作、去 AI 味、封面图，13 件全流程。
skills.tagline_en: A web-fiction production line: chart-scanning, deconstruction, writing, de-AI-flavoring, covers — 13 pieces.
skills.desc_en: 网文/小说写作 skill 包，覆盖长篇与短篇网络小说的扫榜、拆文、写作、去AI味、封面图全流程
skills.why_zh: 中文互联网最生猛的 skill 包之一：不是教你写作，是直接把网文生产线搬进 Claude Code。
skills.why_en: One of the most ambitious packs on the Chinese internet — it installs the production line, not writing tips.

skills.name: huashu-design
skills.tagline_zh: 花叔出品：一句需求，产出高保真 HTML 原型、幻灯片和动画。
skills.tagline_en: From Huashu: one request in, hi-fi HTML prototypes, slides and motion out.
skills.desc_en: 花叔Design——用HTML做高保真原型、幻灯片、动画、可视化与专家评审。任何新设计100%先出三个方向初稿给用户选（指定风格/品牌也不豁免），选定后才执行。触发词：做原型、PPT、幻灯片、动画、设计风格、评审、做个HTML页面、UI mockup、导出MP4/GIF、做个好看的。生产级Web App/需后端的系统不适用。
skills.why_zh: 中文社区口碑最好的设计 skill：不只给样式，还给审美立场——附赠的 20 条设计哲学正是大多数 AI 页面缺的东西。
skills.why_en: The Chinese community's best-loved design skill — it ships a point of view (20 design principles), not just styles.

skills.name: sprite-gen
skills.tagline_zh: 一句话出一套干净的 2D 精灵图：状态行、透明底、逐帧拆好。
skills.tagline_en: One line, one clean sprite sheet — state rows, alpha, frames split.
skills.desc_en: Generate clean 2D game sprites and animation atlases with a component-row pipeline: base identity, numeric sprite-request SSoT, per-state layout guides, image-gen row strips, chroma-key alpha cleanup, connected-component frame extraction, cell-based atlas composition, QA reports, and runtime manifest frame_layout. Its curation webview also serves ANY image-candidate set (icons, logos, generated dr
skills.why_zh: 游戏素材是独立开发最大的坑之一，它把「画小人」变成了一句话的事，产物直接进引擎。
skills.why_en: Art is indie dev's biggest wall; this turns "draw me a sprite" into a one-liner with engine-ready output.

skills.name: video-shotcraft
skills.tagline_zh: 用 Remotion 拍电影感产品视频：106 张分镜配方卡，一句话出片。
skills.tagline_en: Cinematic product videos via Remotion — 106 shot recipes, one prompt to film.
skills.desc_en: Create cinematic product videos from shot recipe cards, a validated template, and code/audio assets (Remotion + real page screenshots + 2.5D camera moves + beat-synced cuts + sound design). Use when the user asks to turn a frontend project or webpage into a product video, says "use video-shotcraft to make a video/promo", names the Ink Press template or asks to reproduce its effect, or wants a sing
skills.why_zh: 把「拍产品宣传片」这种要外包的活变成了本地技能，分镜卡的设计尤其讲究。
skills.why_en: Turns "hire a studio" into a local skill; the shot recipe cards are unusually well crafted.

skills.name: algorithmic-art
skills.tagline_zh: 说一句「来点赛博山水」，看它现场写 p5.js 给你画出来。
skills.tagline_en: Say "cyber landscape" and watch it write p5.js that paints one, live.
skills.desc_en: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
skills.why_zh: 官方 skill 里最好玩的一个：流场、粒子、种子随机都封装好了，体验的是「AI 亲手作画」，不是调图库。
skills.why_en: The most playful official skill — flow fields, particles and seeded randomness pre-wired; real generative art, not stock images.

skills.name: caveman
skills.tagline_zh: 让 Claude 像原始人一样说话：「为什么用很多 token，少 token 就行」。
skills.tagline_en: Claude talks caveman: "why use many token when few token do trick."
skills.desc_en: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is reques
skills.why_zh: 一个玩笑做成了真产品：token 账单实打实地降（据称 65%），还顺手治好了 AI 的啰嗦病。
skills.why_en: A joke that became a product — real token savings (claimed 65%), and it cures verbosity as a side effect.

skills.name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
skills.tagline_zh: 一个人 + Claude Code = 一间游戏工作室：策划、美术、程序全包。
skills.tagline_en: You + Claude Code = a game studio: design, art, code, all covered.
skills.desc_en: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system
skills.why_zh: 把游戏开发拆成可指挥的流水线角色，独立开发者照着走真能出 demo，野心和完成度都在线。
skills.why_en: Splits gamedev into commandable roles; solo devs actually ship demos with it.

skills.name: ponytail
skills.tagline_zh: 请一位「躺平但靠谱」的资深工程师进驻：能不写的代码绝不写。
skills.tagline_en: An unbothered senior engineer moves in: writes no code that needn't exist.
skills.desc_en: Lazy senior dev mode for any coding task (write, refactor, fix, review): YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. Not for non-coding requests.
skills.why_zh: 反内卷的工程精髓——它总在问「这真的需要做吗」，治过度设计比写代码更省钱。
skills.why_en: Its favorite question is "do we even need this?" — killing overengineering saves more than writing code.

skills.name: taste-skill
skills.tagline_zh: 往你的 agent 里注入「品味」：设计、审美、克制，三件套。
skills.tagline_en: Inject taste into your agent: design sense, restraint, judgment.
skills.desc_en: Gives your AI good taste. Stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop
skills.why_zh: 它赌品味可以被写下来——那份审美守则读完你会点头，装完输出确实不土了。
skills.why_en: Bets that taste can be written down. Read its rules and you'll nod; install it and outputs stop looking cheap.

skills.name: baoyu-skills
skills.tagline_zh: 宝玉老师的日常工具箱：翻译、配图、漫画、图表，一次打包。
skills.tagline_en: Baoyu's daily toolbox — translation, illustrations, comics, diagrams, bundled.
skills.desc_en: 宝玉的 Claude 技能合集：翻译、写作、播客、信息处理等中文场景技能包
skills.why_zh: 中文 AI 圈最勤快的实践者之一，每件都是他自己天天在用的东西，密度极高。
skills.why_en: From one of the most prolific practitioners in the Chinese AI scene — tools he actually uses daily.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.tagline_zh: 让 Claude 自己写 skill 的 skill——套娃，但真有用。
skills.tagline_en: The skill that writes skills. Recursive, and genuinely useful.
skills.desc_en: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
skills.why_zh: 把写 skill 的最佳实践（触发词、结构、反例）固化成流程，是整个生态的元工具：想做自己的 skill，先装它。
skills.why_en: Best practices for triggers, structure and anti-patterns, baked in — the meta-tool of this whole ecosystem.

skills.name: humanizer
skills.tagline_zh: 一键去 AI 味：删掉「值得注意的是」和排比腔，像人写的。
skills.tagline_en: Strip the AI-isms — no more "it's worth noting", no triple parallelism.
skills.desc_en: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing text to make it sound more natural and human-written. Based on Wikipedia's comprehensive "Signs of AI writing" guide. Detects and fixes patterns including: inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, passive voice, negative
skills.why_zh: 34k 星不是白来的：它列的「AI 写作臭味清单」极其具体，反过来读就是一堂写作课。
skills.why_en: 34k stars earned — its catalog of AI writing smells is so specific it doubles as a writing course.

skills.name: story-cover
skills.tagline_zh: 网文封面一键出图：书名字效、氛围、平台规范它都懂。
skills.tagline_en: Web-novel covers in one go — title lettering, mood, platform specs included.
skills.desc_en: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 直接生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。
skills.why_zh: 对主流平台的封面套路研究得很透，出的图真能直接上架用。
skills.why_en: Studies platform cover conventions closely enough that outputs are upload-ready.

skills.name: canvas-design
skills.tagline_zh: 不开 Figma，直接让 Claude 出海报级的视觉稿。
skills.tagline_en: Poster-grade visuals straight from Claude, no Figma session needed.
skills.desc_en: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
skills.why_zh: 官方演示「设计品味可以写进提示词」的样本：配色、排版约束写得极细，值得抄作业。
skills.why_en: An official proof that taste can be written down — its color and layout constraints are worth stealing.

skills.name: AnythingButLaw
skills.tagline_zh: 合同、条款、律师函——让它翻成人话，再决定签不签。
skills.tagline_en: Contracts and legalese, translated into plain speech before you sign.
skills.desc_en: 法外功夫 — Non-legal business skills for lawyers. Decision analysis, game theory, contract design, accounting, finance, microeconomics, law & economics, statistics, and regression analysis distilled into deep, actionable frameworks for legal practice. Each domain includes formulas with LaTeX notation, worked examples, adversarial checklists, and book-aligned structure. | 律师必备的非法律商业技能深度参考：决策分析、博弈论、合同设计
skills.why_zh: 不装律师，只做「看懂」这一件事：逐条解释加风险点标注，普通人签字前过一遍很安心。
skills.why_en: Doesn't play lawyer — just makes you understand: clause-by-clause explanation with flagged risks.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.tagline_zh: 强制发散：一次给你二十个方向，先量后质。
skills.tagline_en: Forced divergence: twenty directions first, judgment later.
skills.desc_en: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
skills.why_zh: 流程里带「禁止过早收敛」的纪律，比自己干想有效得多。
skills.why_en: Bakes in a no-premature-convergence rule — beats staring at a blank page.

skills.name: slack-gif-creator
skills.tagline_zh: 给团队 Slack 造专属 GIF 表情，程序化生成不求人。
skills.tagline_en: Custom Slack GIFs, generated programmatically on demand.
skills.desc_en: Knowledge and utilities for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack. Provides constraints, validation tools, and animation concepts. Use when users request animated GIFs for Slack like "make me a GIF of X doing Y for Slack."
skills.why_zh: 用代码逐帧作画再合成 GIF 的思路很妙，改几个参数就是自家的梗图流水线。
skills.why_en: Draws frames in code, then assembles the GIF — tweak a few params and it's your meme pipeline.

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.tagline_zh: 前端专用品味包：字距、留白、层级的洁癖清单。
skills.tagline_en: Frontend taste, itemized: tracking, whitespace, hierarchy.
skills.desc_en: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
skills.why_zh: 把「看起来贵」拆成可执行规则，照着改三处，页面气质就不一样。
skills.why_en: Decomposes "looks expensive" into executable rules — change three things and feel the difference.

skills.name: baoyu-comic
skills.tagline_zh: 把一段观点画成四格或条漫，宝玉同款画风。
skills.tagline_en: Turn an argument into a four-panel comic, Baoyu-style.
skills.desc_en: Knowledge comic creator supporting multiple art styles and tones. Creates original educational comics with detailed panel layouts and batch-capable image generation. Use when user asks to create "知识漫画", "教育漫画", "biography comic", "tutorial comic", or "Logicomix-style comic".
skills.why_zh: 分镜和台词的提示词打磨得很细，出图有叙事感，不是贴图拼盘。
skills.why_en: Carefully tuned paneling and dialogue prompts — the output tells a story, not a collage.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.tagline_zh: 专治 AI 生成页面那股一眼假的「模板味」。
skills.tagline_en: The cure for that instantly-recognizable AI template look.
skills.desc_en: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
skills.why_zh: 一整套设计令牌和排版纪律，让输出有主见：字体、留白、层级全是硬约束，不是口号。
skills.why_en: Design tokens plus typographic discipline as hard constraints — opinionated output, not vibes.

skills.name: brand-guidelines
skills.tagline_zh: 把品牌规范喂给它，从此每份产出都不跑偏。
skills.tagline_en: Feed it your brand book; every output stays on-brand after that.
skills.desc_en: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
skills.why_zh: 价值在示范：教你把「品牌一致性」写成机器能执行的规则，照抄结构就能做自家版本。
skills.why_en: A worked example of encoding brand consistency as executable rules — copy the structure for your own brand.

skills.name: api-and-interface-design
skills.tagline_zh: 设计 API 前先让它过一遍：命名、错误、版本一次到位。
skills.tagline_en: Run your API past it first — naming, errors, versioning, sorted.
skills.desc_en: Guides stable API and interface design. Use when designing APIs, module boundaries, or any public interface. Use when creating REST or GraphQL endpoints, defining type contracts between modules, or establishing boundaries between frontend and backend.
skills.why_zh: 浓缩了大厂 API review 里最常见的那些意见，等于随身带一位严格的接口评审人。
skills.why_en: Condenses the recurring feedback of big-co API reviews into a pocket reviewer.

skills.name: image-to-code
skills.tagline_zh: 丢一张截图，还原成有品味的代码，而不是像素堆。
skills.tagline_en: Drop a screenshot, get tasteful code back — not a pixel dump.
skills.desc_en: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping o
skills.why_zh: 难点在还原「设计意图」而非像素级复刻，它在这个取舍上做得很聪明。
skills.why_en: Recovers design intent rather than chasing pixel parity — the smart trade-off.

skills.name: prompt-master
skills.tagline_zh: 把你的糙 prompt 重写成专业级：结构、示例、边界一次补齐。
skills.tagline_en: Rewrites your rough prompt into a pro one — structure, examples, edge cases.
skills.desc_en: Generates optimized prompts for AI tools. Activates only when the user explicitly asks to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool (LLM, Cursor, Midjourney, image AI, video AI, coding agents, etc.). Does not activate for general conversation, coding tasks, document writing, or other non-prompt-engineering work.
skills.why_zh: 相当于内置一位提示词工程师；改完的 prompt 复用价值高，适合沉淀成团队词库。
skills.why_en: A prompt engineer on call; the rewrites are reusable enough to seed a team library.

skills.name: i-have-adhd
skills.tagline_zh: 给 ADHD 大脑定制的相处模式：短句、一次一件事、绝不啰嗦。
skills.tagline_en: Claude tuned for ADHD brains: short lines, one thing at a time, zero rambling.
skills.desc_en: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".
skills.why_zh: 少见的认真对待神经多样性的 skill，交互约束写得很体贴；非 ADHD 用户拿来治 AI 话痨也好用。
skills.why_en: A rare skill that takes neurodivergence seriously — and its anti-rambling rules help everyone.

skills.name: theme-factory
skills.tagline_zh: 一句话生成整套配色主题，页面气质当场换血。
skills.tagline_en: One line in, a full color theme out — instant personality transplant.
skills.desc_en: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.
skills.why_zh: 产出的是结构化 design tokens 而不是一张灵感图，能直接落进代码，这点比配色网站实用。
skills.why_en: Outputs structured design tokens, not a mood image — drops straight into code.

skills.name: browser-testing-with-devtools
skills.tagline_zh: 让 agent 自己驱动 DevTools：性能、内存、网络一条龙排查。
skills.tagline_en: The agent drives DevTools itself — perf, memory, network, end to end.
skills.desc_en: Tests in real browsers via Chrome DevTools MCP. Use when building or debugging anything that runs in a browser. Use when you need to inspect the DOM, capture console errors, analyze network requests, profile performance, or verify visual output with real runtime data. Requires the chrome-devtools MCP server to be configured.
skills.why_zh: 不是教你开 F12，是让 AI 拿着协议接口自己抓证据，调性能时特别省事。
skills.why_en: Not "open F12" advice — the AI gathers evidence via the protocol itself. Great for perf hunts.

skills.name: baoyu-diagram
skills.tagline_zh: 文字进，示意图出：流程、架构、对比图都行。
skills.tagline_en: Text in, diagrams out — flows, architectures, comparisons.
skills.desc_en: Create professional, dark-themed SVG diagrams of any type — architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, structural diagrams, mind maps, timelines, illustrative/conceptual diagrams, and more. Use this skill whenever the user asks for any kind of technical or conceptual diagram, visualization of a system, process flow, data flow, component relationship, network topology, decision tree, org
skills.why_zh: 图的信息密度控制得好，是「能放进正式文档」的那种图。
skills.why_en: Information density done right — diagrams you can ship in real docs.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.tagline_zh: 先立计划再动手，每步打钩，跑偏自动拉回。
skills.tagline_en: Plan first, then execute — checkboxes per step, drift auto-corrected.
skills.desc_en: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints
skills.why_zh: 治 agent「写着写着忘了目标」的老毛病，长任务成功率肉眼可见地涨。
skills.why_en: Cures the mid-task amnesia problem; long-task success rates visibly climb.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.tagline_zh: 把大任务拆给多个并行分身，各干各的再汇总。
skills.tagline_en: Split the job across parallel agents, then merge the results.
skills.desc_en: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
skills.why_zh: 任务切分与回收的协议写得很清楚，是学 multi-agent 编排的好范本。
skills.why_en: Clean dispatch-and-collect protocol — a solid template for multi-agent orchestration.

skills.name: superpowers
skills.tagline_zh: 给 Claude Code 装上「超能力」全家桶：风暴、分身、按计划施工。
skills.tagline_en: Superpowers for Claude Code: brainstorms, parallel agents, plan-driven work.
skills.desc_en: Battle-tested software engineering skills for Claude Code: TDD, debugging, brainstorming, plans
skills.why_zh: 作者 obra 是老牌开源人，这套把 agent 工作流方法论做成了可安装的零件，是生态里被借鉴最多的仓库之一。
skills.why_en: By veteran open-sourcer obra — agent-workflow methodology as installable parts; one of the most-imitated repos around.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.tagline_zh: 让 Claude 开真浏览器把你的网页点一遍，替你找茬。
skills.tagline_en: Claude drives a real browser through your app and files the bugs.
skills.desc_en: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
skills.why_zh: 基于 Playwright 的自动巡检：选择器、等待策略这些最烦人的细节官方都封装好了。
